findings.negative_performance_result_retained: 16 MiB localized: adaptive 600 body-equivalent bytes, CPU median 86.4015 ms versus Raw 35.2865 ms; wall median 99.909 ms versus Raw 48.9755 ms. Unrelated structured adaptive also costs more CPU.
findings.interpretation: Pass establishes byte-minimum correctness over configured candidates and recorded exact reconstruction; it does not establish a general CPU or elapsed-time win.

limitations: Local, serial, same-process measurement on a shared developer host; no new WAN result.
Body equivalents omit transport headers, TLS, TCP/IP, retransmission and relays; no pure network-send-time result.
CPU includes receiver work and nested timers are not additive; no energy or peak-memory qualification.
Whole-file no-base zstd comparator absent; unrelated-prefix wins do not prove useful cache reuse.
Not a global vulnerability, CUI/FIPS, production security or MVM integration assessment.
Historical WAN results remain prior evidence, not current selector measurements.
